tablet.notes:
Voice messages, videos and other attachments are downloaded as soon as they arrive, so they play right away instead of showing Loading.
Settings > Resize screens now takes effect at once on Chats, Groups and Calls.
Since the last update: Layout screen (dock side now with Bottom), Add to home screen, notifications leave when read on the flip phone.
